title: Governance timeline Base Mainnet deployment plan
deploymentFlow: build GovernanceTimeline bytecode from Idris2/Yul sources
submit CREATE transaction on Base Mainnet via t-ECDSA signer
verify implementation bytecode hash against build/solc/GovernanceTimeline.bin
notes: Base Mainnet broadcast is intentionally separated from artifact production.
The implementation is read-only and intended for delegatecall execution behind an ERC-7546 proxy.
TheWorld canister signs the deployment transaction with t-ECDSA.
